youtube.description:
Dadi ne poocha: "Shubh muhurat dekh kar operation karwayein?" 🗓️
Dr Saathi ne kaha: Dadi, sabse shubh muhurat — jab doctor kahein! 💚

Sach kya hai?
✅ Emergency operation mein der mat kijiye — muhurat ka intezaar nahi
✅ Appendix jaisi bimari mein der se haalat bigad sakti hai (appendix phat sakta hai)
✅ Planned operation ki taareekh apne doctor ke saath milkar tay kijiye
✅ Taareekh badalni ho toh pehle doctor se poochhiye — kuch bimariyon (jaise cancer) mein lambi der nuksaan kar sakti hai
Tez pet dard, bukhaar ya ulti ho toh turant doctor ko dikhaiye
